source: atelier-shazak (établi, murs et formes vides, sections notées 4-5), gwenanou-print (textures, croquis, faisceau laser, notées 4-5), kabooca (couture sellier), menuizim (bois de bout, établi), laure-polin (bronze, ardoise, gomme, notée 4-5), alaingarcia (atelier de tatouage sans tatouage), will-midoux (établi du cuir, noté 4-5) ; échec winsbike-atelier (étrier impossible).
style: Photorealistic editorial still life for a high-end craft workshop, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, soft raking light that reveals the texture of the material, gentle shadows, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, calm and tactile, modern minimal composition with generous negative space.
interdits: No finished piece, no artwork, no product presented as the craftsman's own work, no branded machine, no tattoo designs, no people's faces.
evite: Évite la fausse réalisation du client et le geste mal compris : on montre l'établi, les outils au repos, la matière brute et la lumière.

404.consigne: A hand-stitched seam interrupted halfway, one loose thread dangling and the needle lying next to it on {matieres}, raking light, a gentle touch of humour.
404.evite: L'objet détruit, qui dévaloriserait le savoir-faire.

ouverture.consigne: Wide top-down view of {sujet} filling the frame on a pale workbench, a few curls of fine shavings near one edge, a faint wisp of dust in the light, the central area completely empty and smooth.

section-fond.consigne: An empty traditional workbench in a bright craft studio, worn pale oak top, a few classic hand tools neatly laid out on the right third, nothing being made, no people, no hands.
section-fond.evite: Les mains et la pièce en cours, sources d'erreurs.

scene-metier.consigne: Over-the-shoulder view of anonymous hands {sujet}, only hands and forearms visible, face out of frame, tools without any brand marking, careful and precise work.
scene-metier.evite: La troisième main et l'outil tenu à l'envers : un seul geste simple, deux mains d'une même personne.

lieu.consigne: Small tidy workshop interior, shelves with stacked raw materials, a window with soft daylight, a few plants, nobody in the room, no brand marking on any machine.
lieu.evite: L'atelier présenté comme le vrai lieu du client.

texture.consigne: Straight-on macro photograph of {matieres}, fine natural grain, evenly lit with soft raking light, filling the whole frame edge to edge, usable as a texture.
texture.evite: La texture recadrée sur un objet reconnaissable.

portrait-generique.consigne: Seen from behind in soft window backlight, a craftsperson in a plain work apron bent over a workbench, face never visible, hands hidden by the body, dust floating in the light.
portrait-generique.source: règles atelier-shazak et laure-polin (ni visage, ni mains)
portrait-generique.evite: Le portrait de l'artisan, qui doit venir des vraies photos.
